auto_fail_flags.label: Financial thesis buried
auto_fail_flags.description: The seller never raised payback, ROI, margin, or the P&L case.

auto_fail_flags.label: Change-management adoption ignored
auto_fail_flags.description: The seller never addressed how the organization adopts the change.

artifact: One-page AWS-style PRFAQ and CFO P&L business case

transition_banner.title: Lead with the answer. Close with the P&L.
transition_banner.body: Executives decide on the financial thesis in the first minute.

drills.title: Executive answer first
drills.prompt: Open with the decision you need, then name the economic buyer and the number they will sign against.

drills.title: Multi-year business case
drills.prompt: Show the multi-year case against the buyer's criteria, grouped into the branches that carry the decision.

drills.title: Adoption and change management
drills.prompt: Confirm the champion will drive adoption, then tie the pain to the rollout plan and its training.

boss_fight.title: Boss fight · Executive close
boss_fight.learner_brief: Close a multi-year enterprise deal with the executive committee. Lead with the answer and hold the P&L on one page.
